performanceRequirement: RC40 remains unqualified; unchanged 120-second whole recovery and 10-second read budgets.

assessment.readinessBoundary: Full fresh inspection at entry before cache/SDK work, and after encrypted CAS plus final SDK mailbox/advance handling; final uncached observed-anchor recheck precedes both recovering and complete returns.
assessment.intermediateAuthentication: Every existing recheck call remains and still validates numbered header hash against exact captured anchor with pre/post context checks. Speculative old-anchor, promotion old/new anchors, pre/post-CAS and final advance fences are retained.
assessment.independentSdkAuthority: Unchanged runRollingPreferenceRecovery canonicalSnapshot and page canonical code verify expected node network/proof identity, exact numbered anchor/header, contract class/address, archive/receipt/body validators and original commit boundaries. Reader readiness is not the sole authentication authority.
assessment.durableFailureSemantics: Final readiness veto returns no progress/preferences; an already committed authenticated SDK/cache page is retained for the ordinary explicit next-read mailbox/replay path. No automatic retry or fallback was introduced.
assessment.lifecycleAndPrivacy: No contextGuard, abort/drain ownership, active-reader lifetime, selector shape, range, log/byte bounds, encryption domain, mailbox/CAS sequence or transport policy changed. No readiness result is cached across reads.
assessment.simplicity: Two reader helpers plus one final call relocation; no new lifecycle, scheduler, network primitive or timeout.

coverage: entry readiness refusal without SDK page/cache write
eight final identity/proof/stale/unsynced veto cases across recovering/complete after durable CAS and mailbox
post-CAS reorg, marker/anchor advancement and lost delivery/CAS paths
account invalidation and pending operation ownership after abort
bounded public transport, malformed/oversize input, no retry
labelled call-cost clock regression under unchanged 10-second deadline
independentChecks.testLimits: Reader tests execute real AEAD/CAS/fold with labelled SDK/node/provenance doubles; latency test uses controlled time/call costs, not measured network performance.

workerEvidence.beforeFailure: Retained original c803 plus new latency regression fails; worker log hash checked, not rerun independently.
workerEvidence.exactHistoricalCause: The observed 10.490-second failure and repeated snapshot cost support the repair, but generic historical failure does not establish the cause of every earlier failure.

limits: No live repaired recovery, full 120-second success, generated closure, real-proof/testnet or specialist privacy acceptance claimed.
Owning normal generated asset closure and exact integration mapping remain lead work before deployment.
reviewerActions: Read-only source and evidence inspection plus existing reader/transport tests. No browser/native/model/build/financial actions.
